message.reasoning:
We need to fix compilation errors. Mainly test code includes many imports for Mockito, but we don't have dependencies. Simplify: remove Mockito usage and annotations, use plain objects. Also many stub classes incorrectly implement interfaces. JsonSchema is likely a class (abstract class) not interface, so implements wrong. We can instead extend JsonSchema. Let's inspect library? In networknt schema, JsonSchema is abstract class. So we should have StubJsonSchema extends JsonSchema. Also we need to provide constructors matching superclass. The constructor of JsonSchema expects (ValidationContext validationContext, JsonNode schemaNode, JsonSchema parentSchema). In code we gave super(null,null,null). That's okay if protected.

But many methods missing: need to import correct types: Validator, SchemaType, etc. Those are in library; we can just not implement them by extending JsonSchema and not overriding those methods; but BaseStubJsonSchema overrides many methods with @Override causing errors because method signatures may differ (e.g., setValidator expects Validator type). If we don't need those overrides, we can remove BaseStubJsonSchema entirely and just use JsonSchema subclass that only overrides initializeValidators. Simpler: create TestJsonSchema extends JsonSchema and implement needed abstract methods (if any). Let's check JsonSchema abstract methods in library: there is abstract void initializeValidators(); maybe also other methods are concrete, not abstract. I'd need to approximate.

Simplify test code: remove BaseStubJsonSchema and StubJsonSchema etc. Keep only TestJsonSchema extends JsonSchema and implements initializeValidators, plus maybe constructor calling super.

Also remove StubValidationContext usage? There's test that uses real ValidationContext via anonymous subclass; that may also need constructor arguments. In library ValidationContext likely has a constructor with many params. In test they used new ValidationContext(null,null,null,null,null) and override newSchema. So that's okay.

But earlier they used StubValidationContext extends ValidationContext with no-arg constructor causing error. We can just remove that stub and not use it. The only place where StubValidationContext used is in test preloadJsonSchema_executesWithoutException? Actually they don't use StubValidationContext there; they create validationContext inline. So we can delete StubValidationContext class entirely.

Also remove import of Mockito, @ExtendWith, @Mock etc. Remove those annotations and fields.

Simplify test: we don't need mocked validationContext etc because they aren't used. The test fields validationContext, parentSchema, childSchema1/2 are never used. We can delete them.

Thus resulting test class uses only OneOfValidator, TestJsonSchema, etc.

Need to import required classes: java.util.ArrayList, java.util.List, java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentModificationException, org.junit.jupiter.api.*, java.lang.reflect.Field, java.io.IOException, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.*, com.networknt.schema.*.

Remove imports for Mockito.

Now adjust code accordingly.

Also need to adjust createValidator: it currently passes (null,null) for ValidationContext? Actually OneOfValidator constructor signature: (String path, JsonNode schemaNode, JsonSchema parentSchema, ValidationContext validationContext). They call new OneOfValidator("testPath", schemaNode, null, null); That's fine.

Now define TestJsonSchema:

class TestJsonSchema extends JsonSchema { // need constructor

public TestJsonSchema() { super(null,null,null); }

fields as before, implement initializeValidators method.

Also need to implement any abstract methods from JsonSchema that are not default. Let's look at JsonSchema in networknt. I recall it's abstract class with many methods abstract: void initializeValidators(); void validate(JsonNode node, JsonNode rootNode, String at); maybe some others. But can we leave them unimplemented? We'll need to provide implementations (maybe empty) for abstract methods: validate, etc. Provide them throwing UnsupportedOperationException.

Thus we can define methods: public void validate(JsonNode node, JsonNode rootNode, String at) { throw new UnsupportedOperationException(); }

Also maybe getter for schemaNode, etc. But we can just implement as needed.

Simplify: Provide implementations for methods required by abstract class: getSchemaNode(), setParentSchema(), getParentSchema(), setPath(), getPath(), setValidator(Validator), getValidator(), setSchema(JsonNode), getSchema(), setSchemaPath(String), getSchemaPath(), setSchemaLocation(String), getSchemaLocation(), setSchemaVersion(SpecVersion.VersionFlag), getSchemaVersion(), setValidatorType(ValidatorTypeCode), getValidatorType(), setSchemaType(SchemaType), getSchemaType(), setReference(String), getReference(), setReferenceSchema(JsonSchema), getReferenceSchema(). These were previously overridden in BaseStubJsonSchema. We can copy those as concrete methods throwing UnsupportedOperationException.

Thus we can keep BaseStubJsonSchema but modify to extend JsonSchema (not implement) and remove @Override annotation errors due to mismatched signatures maybe. The errors were because JsonSchema is a class, not interface; but overriding works still. The error was "interface expected here" because implements JsonSchema (interface). So change "static class StubJsonSchema implements JsonSchema" to "extends JsonSchema". Also BaseStubJsonSchema extends JsonSchema already, okay.

But the many @Override errors were because methods in BaseStubJsonSchema didn't match signatures of abstract methods? Actually they likely match, but errors may be due to missing import for Validator, SchemaType etc. Those classes are part of library; they exist, but compile error earlier for missing imports maybe. The errors: cannot find symbol: class Validator; class SchemaType. They are in same package com.networknt.schema. So need to import them: import com.networknt.schema.Validator; import com.networknt.schema.SchemaType; Also maybe SpecVersion.VersionFlag is inner class of SpecVersion; import com.networknt.schema.SpecVersion; import com.networknt.schema.ValidatorTypeCode; Already they referenced those without imports; they might be in same package so no import needed. But need Validator import.

Add import for com.networknt.schema.Validator; and com.networknt.schema.SchemaType; Also ValidatorTypeCode is same package.

Now fix StubJsonSchema class: change implements to extends JsonSchema and provide constructor super(null,null,null). Also remove duplicate StubJsonSchema vs BaseStub... Actually StubJsonSchema used in StubValidationContext but we will delete StubValidationContext, so we can delete StubJsonSchema too.

Thus we can remove StubJsonSchema and StubValidationContext entirely.

Now edit test file accordingly.

Let's craft corrected code.
